svg.aria-label: Stack. GENERATIVE AI: RAG, AI agents, Tool calling, MCP, Embeddings, Semantic search, Prompt engineering, LLM evaluation. AI PLATFORMS + DATA: Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Hugging Face, Pinecone, ChromaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis. LANGUAGES + BACKEND: Python, TypeScript, Java 17, Swift, JavaScript, SQL, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Node.js, REST APIs, Microservices, Apache Kafka. CLOUD + SHIPPING: AWS, EKS, Lambda, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare Workers, Electron, WebRTC, Chrome MV3, Code signing.
